F Frogging Nook Connection over competition 2026

Frogging Nook is more than a crochet brand: it is a shared space for creativity, connection and new beginnings.

Each rounded form in the mark is a maker, a learner or a creator, separate but connected, together making the Nook. The typeface is bold yet gentle, carrying the rhythm of creating, undoing and growing together.

Tote bags, yarn bands, swing tags, stickers, woven labels and the Bloom & Stitch workshop poster.
